turns.question: What was the order cancellation rate in August 2026, as cancelled amount divided by total order amount, not the average of daily cancellation rates?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for cancelled amount divided by total order amount, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metric is Cancellation rate (share of orders cancelled, counted by order, not by amount), which was 8.3% for 1 to 31 August 2026 (5 cancelled of 60 orders). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
